But what Commandements are those that God hath 4nd to
given us? Are all those Laws which were given to the wat
Jews by the hand of Moses, the Commandements of /#*-
God? If they bee, why are not Christians taught to
Obey them? If they be not, what others are so, besides
the Law of Nature? For our Saviour Christ hath not
given us new Laws, but Counsell to observe those wee
are subject to; that is to say, the Laws of Nature, and
the Laws of our severall Soveraigns: Nor did he make
any new Law to the Jews in his Sermon on the Mount,
but onely expounded the Laws of Moses, to which they
were subject before. The Laws of God therefore are none
but the Laws of Nature, whereof the principall is, that
we should not violate our Faith, that is, a commande-
ment to obey our Civill Soveraigns, which wee constituted
over us, by mutuall pact one with another. And this
Law of God, that commandeth Obedience to the Law
_ Civill, commandeth by consequence Obedience to all the
| Precepts of the Bible; which (as I have proved in the
precedent Chapter) is there onely Law, where the Civill
Soveraign hath made it so; and in other places but
Counsell ; which a man at his own perill, may without
injustice refuse to obey.
